resources.string: Determines the initial settings upon cold start. Parameters changed in the camera view are remembered and will not reset on background process kill.
Whether to record without an audio track by default. Automatically falls back to video-only if microphone permission is missing.
Frames with brightness difference below this threshold will not be merged. Higher values are more conservative; lower values may merge noise.

This setting only applies to the camera recording view. Settings, Gallery, and Player follow system auto-rotation. Takes effect immediately upon returning to the camera view and persists across app restarts.
Only affects panel and button transitions, scale, and fade animations
Top row contains persistent readouts (defaults to Shutter / FPS / Bitrate). Bottom row contains camera control pills. Unchecking removes them from the viewfinder.

Sliders snap to scale increments by default. Selecting a parameter below switches its slider to continuous values, allowing free adjustment (e.g. 1.2x, 1.7x zoom). Exposure Compensation, Zebra Threshold, and Merge Threshold always adjust by discrete steps and are excluded.
Determines reference lines enabled by default on cold start. Lines changed in the camera view are remembered and will not reset on background cleanup.
Gives a subtle vibration feedback at level alignment. Disabled for both when turned off.
Check interval for dual-video audio alignment, cross-segment transitions, and loop wraps. Smaller intervals track tighter; larger intervals save battery. Takes effect immediately.
Adjustable independently per screen, 100% is default. Reduce on smaller displays if text encroaches on the viewfinder.
Without microphone only video is recorded. Without video access, recorded videos will not appear in gallery.
All data is kept locally on this device. Internet is only accessed when checking for updates.

When enabled, delete, trash, restore, and rename operations apply directly to all device videos without system confirmation prompts. If disabled, only videos recorded by this app can be modified.
Current system (Android 10) does not support \"All Files Access\". File actions only apply to videos recorded/exported by this app.
Hides the control from the viewfinder when unchecked. Shutter button, gallery thumbnail, and settings shortcut cannot be hidden.

Only enabled controls above can be edited: Drag container to move, drag items inside container to reorder, or drag into other containers. Tap \"Save\" to apply immediately to the camera view; persists across restarts. Layout does not reset when items are hidden; use \"Reset Defaults\" in the editor to restore factory layout.
Viewfinder control backgrounds show blurred real-time footage. Only effective in GPU mode; turn off to return to standard appearance.
